reason: Our system has run for years and the vendor knows our club; I'm not taking a two-person startup with no live club to my board just to get an app in our own colours. The free pilot is generous, but it still costs my volunteers and our office months of double work.
objection: Two founders and not a single club live yet. If one of them quits, I'm the one explaining to 950 members why tee times and invoices are in trouble, and €399 a month comes on top of what we already pay.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle live for a full season, their board telling me on the phone it went smoothly, and the bar tab linked to the card machine and cash register we already have.
